name: wemind
description: WeMind — your AI mind, reachable on WeChat. Monorepo: reusable iLink protocol core, a publishable MCP server, and a publishable always-on daemon CLI (wemind).

scripts.verify:code: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.verify:publish: npm run build && npm run check:version && npm run pack:check
scripts.verify:docs: npm run check:user-copy && npm run check:agent-docs && npm run check:tables && npm run check:impact && npm run check:links
scripts.verify: npm run verify:publish && npm run verify:code && npm run verify:docs
scripts.hook:check: npm run --silent format:check && node scripts/doc-impact.mjs --check --staged && npm run --silent check:user-copy && npm run --silent check:agent-docs
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --workspace @wemind/cli --no-git-tag-version && npm run check:version
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --workspace @wemind/cli --no-git-tag-version && npm run check:version
scripts.release:major: npm version major --workspace @wemind/cli --no-git-tag-version && npm run check:version
